cleared.check: Task 1 (L-1318). The TIP-1060 storage credit region of the v1.19.2 x86_64 SSTORE handler (0x42b46b8 to the exit 0x42b5095, with the out-of-line blocks 0x42b50f1 to 0x42b5175), run from its disassembly in the cycle 28/29 x86-64 model, followed by the dynamic gas, the EIP-8037 block and the refund routine 0x2d26f80. The PoolManager write and its journal entries came first from the handler's own segments 0x42b44c4 to 0x42b46b8. The transient credit state calls 0x1e8fd10 (tload) and 0x1e8feb0 (tstore) ran from the binary on real transient tables, the SstoreTransitionFlags block 0x4b632b9 to 0x4b633e7 of the outlined host sstore ran from the binary, and the credit slot reads and writes went through the handler's own warm, write and StorageChange segments. Cases: PoolManager slot shapes (slot0, liquidity, a tick word, fee growth, a position word, protocolFeesAccrued, an ERC-6909 balance), original zero or not, present and new each zero, equal to the original or another value, warm and cold PoolManager and credit slots, gas at, one below and one above every check, credit words 0, 1, 2, 20, 2^64-2, 2^64-1, 2^64, 2^64+5 and 2^256-1, transient credit words in Refund, Preserve and Direct mode with budgets 0, 1, 5 and 2^64-1 and invalid mode bytes 3 and 255, pre-T7 spec, EIP-2200 off, the credit precompile itself as owner, and injected database errors on the credit load and the credit write. Seed 2026112838, 71,328 cases, and seed 2026112839, 6,133 cases with a Preserve word that carries a budget.
cleared.result: No input makes the handler write a different PoolManager word, change the original word, skip or add a journal entry, or succeed or fail where accounting.rs, instructions.rs and gas_params.rs at the pinned revisions say otherwise. 0 mismatches in 77,461 cases on stored word, original word, return code (44,153 normal returns, 20,843 OutOfGas halts and 6,332 fatal returns through state.fail in the main run), gas left, refund, persistent credit word, transient credit word and the ordered journal tags (StorageWarmed 5, StorageChange 3, transient 4). The binary tests occupancy on present against new (0x42b479d to 0x42b4803), skips the precompile's own address (0x42b4809), charges the warm read before the credit load and the cold surcharge after it with skip_cold taken on the gas left after the warm charge, refuses a credit word of 2^64 or more as fatal, adds one with saturation on a clear (0x42b4b71 to 0x42b4b7b), takes the mode from the low byte of limb 0 and refuses modes above 2, charges 245,000 gas (0x3bd08) in Refund and Preserve mode, decrements credit and budget in Direct mode and leaves an unlimited budget alone, writes the transient word as [mode, budget, 0, pending], and charges the clean update cost only when the credit write changes a clean slot. A halt returns before the dynamic gas, so the frame's checkpoint undoes the PoolManager write. The credit code writes only to the storage and transient storage of 0x1060000000000000000000000000000000000000 and to the gas counter, so none of the PoolManager writes at src/libraries/Pool.sol:106, 226, 439, 442 and 593, src/libraries/Position.sol:88, src/ERC6909.sol:26-28 and 79-86 or src/ProtocolFees.sol:55 and 68 can be given another value by it. Coverage: 415 of 469 instructions in the credit address range, 20 of 20 in the out-of-line blocks, 74 of 74 in the flags block, 100 of 100 in the refund routine. The 54 unvisited instructions are blocks of the earlier handler part that the compiler placed in this range (0x42b4acc to 0x42b4b54, 0x42b4d1a), the drop of an error already stored in the state (0x42b4a88 to 0x42b4a9c), a combination the host never returns (0x42b4d8c), and the EIP-8037 branch where state gas exceeds the reservoir (0x42b4f49 to 0x42b4f8d), which needs a nonzero SstoreSetState. Modelled, not run: the bodies of 0x4b83c80 and 0x4b62170 before the flags block, that is account loading and slot lookup, and the error object constructors 0x5eb4b90, 0x4293810 and 0x42b5390.

cleared.check: Task 2 (L-1318). Credit writes inside frames that revert at depth 1 to 3: 1,500 random sequences (seed 2026112838) and 300 more (seed 2026112839) of PoolManager writes that cross zero in both directions, under Refund, Preserve and Direct mode words, with State::rollback 0x1e90db0 run from the binary at each reverting frame. After each rollback the credit word, the transient credit word, every PoolManager word, the journal length and the warm flags of all slots were compared with their state before the frame, and each write's gas with the reference.
cleared.result: No credit, budget or pending refund count survives the rollback of the write that produced it: 0 sequences with a credit or transient word kept after a revert, 0 mismatches in PoolManager words, journal length, warm flags or per-write gas. A credit slot loaded cold inside a reverted frame is cold again afterwards and the next write pays the cold surcharge again, as the reference expects. End-of-transaction refund settlement (settle_storage_credit_refunds, crates/evm/src/handler/config.rs:444-486 at c0c9372) runs only for a successful transaction and reads the transient map that the rollback has already restored, so a reverted creation leaves no pending refund to settle. No free gas for a later writer was found.

cleared.check: Who gains from credits the PoolManager accrues. Every clear of a PoolManager slot by any caller (a burned ERC-6909 balance, a cleared tick, a closed position, collected protocol fees) mints one persistent credit to the storage-owning account, the PoolManager. In the default Refund mode each later creation of a PoolManager slot pays 245,000 gas and records a pending refund, which settle_storage_credit_refunds pays back at the end of a successful transaction by spending the PoolManager's credits.
cleared.result: This moves gas cost between users of the PoolManager and never moves funds. A user who creates a slot is refunded from credits that earlier users minted, and an account that drains the credits only makes later creators pay the full creation price, which is the price without credits. The refund goes to the transaction's gas accounting (result.gas.record_refund, config.rs:483-485) and touches no PoolManager slot or token balance. The mode word belongs to the account that calls the precompile (set_mode and set_budget take msg_sender, storage_credits/mod.rs), so no other account can switch the PoolManager to Direct mode. Information only.

cleared.check: Task 4 (L-1336). Does any system call, precompile or fee path hold or credit a native balance after genesis. eth_getProof at the head (block 51,157,365, web3_clientVersion tempo/v1.19.2-c0c9372/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu before and after the batch) on address(0), the fee manager 0xfeec00..00, TIP403Registry, TIP20Factory, StablecoinDEX, StorageCredits 0x1060..00, pathUSD, the EIP-2935 history contract the executor calls at block start, the EIP-4788 address, the system address 0xff..fe, the PoolManager and the four beneficiaries of the last 4,000 blocks. The block executor source at c0c9372 was read for balance changes.
cleared.result: Every proof gives balance 0x0. eth_getBalance answers the fixed placeholder 4242424242424242424242424242424242424242424242424242424242424242424242424242 for every address at every block, so it carries no information. Proofs older than the node's proof window are refused (code 4444), so the history before the window rests on source. apply_pre_execution_changes rejects any block with withdrawals and makes only the EIP-2935 history system call and the committee call (crates/evm/src/block.rs:815-866 and 554-591), and the test at block.rs:1507-1557 shows the Ethereum block reward and DAO paths apply only before T13 and only on a chain spec without Paris. No native balance exists that an account could send, and the handler refuses native value in every transaction type (validate_no_native_value, config.rs:497). So no native credit can be minted with a real value call.

cleared.check: Task 4 (L-1337). Do pools with address(0) as a currency exist on the Tempo PoolManager 0x33620f62c5b9b2086dd6b62f4a297a9f30347029, and what could a position in one do. eth_getLogs over blocks 0 to 51,157,365 in ranges of at most 31,250 blocks (the endpoint caps a query at 100,000) for Initialize logs, all of them and those with topic2 (currency0) equal to zero.
cleared.result: The PoolManager has 168 Initialize logs and none has currency0 = address(0); since currency0 < currency1, no pool on Tempo uses the native currency. If one were created, its native side could never be paid in: settle credits msg.value, which is always 0 on Tempo (src/PoolManager.sol:349-354), and a native take needs a value call the PoolManager cannot fund (src/types/Currency.sol:44-52). A position in range would need native that nobody can deliver. A one-sided ERC-20 position outside the range can be added and removed. A swap that pays ERC-20 for native output leaves the swapper with a native credit it can only clear or mint as claim id 0, which no take can redeem; such claims could be burned to pay the native leg in another address(0) pool, so ERC-20 sitting in such pools could be bought only with native claims that someone first bought with ERC-20. No value appears from nothing, and no such pool exists today.

cleared.check: Does the TIP-1060 storage credit code, its SSTORE hook or its end-of-transaction refund settlement exist on the other 20 networks.
cleared.result: No. TIP-1060 is defined in Tempo's own crates (tempo-precompiles storage_credits and the tempo-evm SSTORE override) and runs only in the Tempo client. This theme concerns Tempo only.

leads.question: Run the bodies of 0x4b83c80 and 0x4b62170 (account load and slot lookup for the credit account) from the binary, and the EIP-8037 reservoir branch 0x42b4f49 to 0x42b4f8d with a nonzero SstoreSetState, once the evm2 GasTracker source for spend_state and refill_reservoir is read. leadResults.answer: Tasks 1, 2 and 5 are done. The credit region of the v1.19.2 x86_64 SSTORE handler, its gas tail, the refund routine, the flags block of the outlined host sstore and the transient credit state routines ran from the binary on 77,461 cases and 1,800 reverting frame sequences with no mismatch against accounting.rs, instructions.rs, gas_params.rs and pyevm.py, and all ten planted faults were caught. The SLOAD miss path from 0x42b6110 was read and located (database call at 0x42a9df9 and 0x42aa204) and not run; the credit host bodies before the flags block were modelled. The miss path half stays open as a new lead.

eth_getProof at the head gives balance 0 for address(0), the fee manager, every precompile, the EIP-2935 and EIP-4788 addresses, the system address, the PoolManager and the four recent beneficiaries. The executor rejects withdrawals and makes no balance increment after T13; eth_getBalance answers a fixed placeholder and proofs before the node's window are refused, so the past rests on source.
Of the 168 Initialize logs of the Tempo PoolManager none has currency0 = address(0), so no native pool exists and no ERC-20 liquidity sits against a native side.
